message.content:
Let \(L_n\) be the length of the red-marked stick after \(n\) minutes.

At the \(n\)-th minute, there are \(n\) sticks total. The red stick is one of them, so the probability it is chosen is \(1/n\). If it is chosen, its length is halved; otherwise its length is unchanged. Thus, conditional on the current length \(L_{n-1}\),
\[
E[L_n\mid L_{n-1}]
= (1-\tfrac1n)L_{n-1}+\tfrac1n\cdot\tfrac{L_{n-1}}2
= L_{n-1}\left(1-\tfrac{1}{2n}\right).
\]
Therefore,
\[
E[L_n]=\left(1-\tfrac{1}{2n}\right)E[L_{n-1}].
\]
Starting from \(E[L_0]=1\), multiply through \(n=1,\ldots,5\):
\[
E[L_5]=\frac12\cdot\frac34\cdot\frac56\cdot\frac78\cdot\frac9{10}
=\frac{63}{256}.
\]

\[
\boxed{\frac{63}{256}}
\]
